name: volume-x
useCase: Indicate muted audio or provide a mute action beside its label.
misuse: Do not use the cross to indicate a broken audio device unless the label states an error.

16.reason: The compact speaker matches volume-high and retains the family’s 45-degree cone edges, leaving 1px before the cross.

24.reason: The compact speaker matches volume-high with separately tuned proportions and at least 1.5px of space before the larger cross.
